title: Acceptance and notification
summary: The act completing acceptance and notice of that act can be different steps.
notes: International Filter’s specified approval dispensed with separate notice, though its letter would have sufficed. White required an appropriate manifestation placed in a reasonable course of communication. Carlill infers that the advertisement dispensed with advance notification of performance. Bishop requires notice where the offeror would not promptly learn of the act. Distinguish notice of a return promise from notice that invited performance has occurred.
